links.outcome: Proportion of LLM-generated vascular surgery management plans rated unsafe by expert panel
links.effect: Unsafe plans were generated in 11.9%, 23.8%, and 7.1% of cases by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, respectively; acute limb ischemia strongly predicted unsafe output (OR 20.9).
links.quote: Unsafe plans were generated in 11.9%, 23.8%, and 7.1% of cases by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, respectively.

links.outcome: Free-response LLM performance in realistic vascular cases versus safety
links.effect: Mean composite scores were 86.5% (ChatGPT), 83.5% (Gemini), 88.0% (Claude), yet unsafe plans occurred in 7.1%-23.8% of cases, so high scores did not ensure safety.
links.quote: Mean composite scores by model were 86.5% for ChatGPT, 83.5% for Gemini, and 88.0% for Claude, whereas scores by disease were 82.7% for ALI, 83.8% for aortopathy, 85.9% for chronic limb ischemia, 86.1% for diabetic foot infection, and 80.7% for extracranial cerebrovascular disease (P>.05 in each case).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and safety of three LLMs on 42 fictitious vascular surgery clinical vignettes scored by a panel, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
